infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoamFit uses your location once, at the end of a workout, to pin the city and country on your Passport. It's never tracked in the background.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: RoamFit does not read any Health data — this permission is unused.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: RoamFit writes each completed workout to Health. It never reads your health data.
